answer: Agents use TPM/SGX enclaves to issue zero-knowledge attestations binding unique hardware keys to measured code; the ledge state tree commits identities, the lantern hash anchor timestamps proofs, and the wharf consensus contract admits them. A Sybil attacker must acquire and continuously run distinct physical silicon or break enclave/proof security; admission follows a quadratic bonding curve O(N^2), and failed attestations trigger irreversible collateral slashing.
